inputs.csv.row: Joint primary row index, stable in predictions and train/test indices
inputs.csv.origin_row: Original disk row or cluster broad_row, interpreted with domain
inputs.csv.ggas_m_s2: Disk-only signed gas inward force. Cluster zeros are unused placeholders, NOT measured missing hot gas. Cluster prediction reads quadrature instead.
inputs.csv.gstar_m_s2: Disk-only stellar inward force. Cluster zeros unused; cluster total baryons remain in gbar.
inputs.csv.gas_force_fraction: Disk-only ggas/(ggas+gstar); blank for cluster; NOT gas mass fraction

predictions.csv.coefficients_json: [eta, log10(Rc/kpc)]; disk-only Rc=400 is externally fixed and absent from kernel
predictions.csv.selected_fit_id: Index in results fits; -1 means frozen coefficients
predictions.csv.split: all, cv_SEED, or source/domain exclusion; frozen-parameter CV labels do not imply retraining

full_disk_predictions.csv.valid_positive_source: False when signed net inward source<=0; predicted values blank, not clipped

metrics.B_dex: RMS log10 acceleration residual with equal domain/source/host weighting as applicable
metrics.median_acceleration_error_percent: Row median abs(gpred/gobs-1)*100; not host weighted
metrics.median_speed_error_percent: Row median abs(sqrt(gpred/gobs)-1)*100; physical circular-speed interpretation only for disks
metrics.valid_conditional_row_RMS_dex: Full-disk diagnostics only: unweighted RMS over valid rows; not primary B and not whole-sample if invalid rows exist
